items.description: Diagnostic inspection of the cracked laptop
items.rationale: The diagnostic measured 41,200 of 52,000 mWh (79.2%), below the 80% threshold in §2.6.8, and no waiver applies. Sections 2.6.7 and 5.2.3 therefore bar reimbursement even for the diagnostic that established ineligibility; €75 is the conditional gross estimate, below the €250 cap.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The swerve and impact meet §2.6.2, but the measured battery capacity of 79.2% makes the entire laptop ineligible under §§2.6.8 and 2.6.7. The €549 parts-and-labour quote shown in the photo is the conditional gross repair estimate, not a payable amount.
